pricing.setupBody: We can create and configure your online store for you. Store creation may be included free of charge or offered for a one-time setup fee, depending on the package agreed with you. After setup, you only pay the SpeedVendors subscription.
pricing.setupFeeTbd: Setup fee: configurable — ask us for current offers.

items.a: No. We can create and configure the store for you. You manage day-to-day operations from the SpeedVendors dashboard.

items.q: Do I need to build my own website?
items.a: No. SpeedVendors provides the storefront and the management platform.
A single SpeedVendors subscription, billed monthly or yearly. Store setup may be free or a one-time fee depending on your offer.

items.q: Can you create my store for me?
items.a: Yes. Store creation and configuration can be handled for you as part of onboarding.
Yes. SpeedVendors integrates with Netopia for online card payments, alongside cash / COD where enabled.

items.q: Can I offer home and locker delivery?
items.a: Yes. Shipping is managed through eAWB with support for home delivery and locker delivery.

items.q: Can I manage everything from one place?
items.a: Yes — products, orders, customers, payments, shipping, invoices and analytics live in one dashboard.
